Wan2.2 A14B on Mac: files, RAM and published times

Wan2.2 A14B is a two-expert video model with a high-noise and a low-noise expert of about 14B parameters each, 27B in total and 14B active per step. It makes 5-second videos at 480P and 720P, and on a Mac it runs through community MLX packs.

Wan-AI · Updated 2026-10-24
Answer

Wan2.2 A14B runs on a Mac with 64 GB or more. A published run on Apple M1 Max · 64 GB used ComfyUI Q5_K_M I2V with the Lightning 4-step LoRA, 480x320, 25 frames, 182.7 s (source).

Does it fit your NVIDIA GPU's VRAM?

Runs · Stated means the linked model card, app maker or NVIDIA says a GPU with that much VRAM runs the model; Runs · Published names the card of a dated run. Fits with offload means the main model weights fit in VRAM with a 15% margin but the full set does not: the text encoder and VAE run from system RAM, which is slower. Exceeds VRAM means even the main weights are too large for the card. Mac runs never count here.

Which Mac software routes are listed?

  • ComfyUI

    Official

    Formats: safetensors, gguf. Memory policy: component stages stay resident.

    On Apple Silicon ComfyUI runs on PyTorch MPS, not MLX. GGUF files need the separate city96/ComfyUI-GGUF custom node. Resident size is the sum of the weights, an upper bound: ComfyUI can unload models between stages and publishes no per-model Mac peak.

    Sources: ComfyUI README · ComfyUI system requirements · ComfyUI CLI arguments · ComfyUI-GGUF README

  • PocketAI Wan2.2 MLX (pocketai-wan-video)

    Community

    Formats: mlx. Memory policy: component stages stay resident.

    Sources: PocketAI Wan2.2 T2V A14B MLX card

What known issues should you check?

  • Known issue 1

    PocketAI packs are community derivatives, not an official Wan-AI release.

    Source: PocketAI Wan2.2 T2V A14B MLX card · Read 2026-10-24

  • Known issue 2

    The PocketAI benchmark carries no run date. The date shown is the repository last-modified date.

    Source: PocketAI Wan2.2 T2V A14B MLX card · Read 2026-10-24

  • Known issue 3

    Wan2.2 A14B needs both experts for a complete run, so every build lists a high-noise and a low-noise file.

    Source: Wan2.2 README · Read 2026-10-24

Frequently asked questions

Does Wan2.2 A14B run on a Mac?

Yes, through community MLX packs. PocketAI's Q4 pack took 10:25 end to end on an M5 Max with 128 GB for a 512x320, 81-frame clip at 10 steps, with a 16.37 GiB peak process RSS. The official card asks for a GPU with at least 80GB VRAM.

Why does Wan2.2 A14B need two expert files?

The A14B design uses a high-noise expert for the early denoising stages and a low-noise expert for later detail refinement. Each has about 14B parameters, giving 27B in total with 14B active per step, so every build lists both files.
